spec.name: RIDGE_HGB_RESIDUAL_120

temporal_model.input: 12 calendar months ending M-1, log1p(RCYL/s), SCTS/calendar_days and separate finite masks; each interacts with normalized horizon powers0..3, plus horizon powers1..3

feature_model.training_target: log1p(RCYL/s) minus same-outer-training-fitted Ridge prediction on those training rows

spec.residual_scope: ordinary additive residual training; no validation prediction or label enters either fit; not nested/cross-fitted stacking
spec.scale: raw last legal RCYL if finite and >0 else1
spec.weights: no sample weights; no tuned blend or routing
spec.not_a_claim: branch names describe intended roles, not a causal decomposition or proven importance
